input.title: Only treat a quote as field-opening at the start of a field
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

splitFields() currently toggles inQuotes on any quote character ("), even mid-field, so a literal inch mark like 27" in an unquoted description starts a phantom quoted field and swallows the rest of the line, producing the "Malformed row" error. Change splitFields() so a quote only opens a quoted field when it occurs at the very start of a field (current === "" and not already inQuotes); a quote elsewhere should be treated as an ordinary character, matching real-world unquoted exports.

file: src/ingest/parser.ts

splitFields() toggles inQuotes on any quote character, even mid-field, so an unescaped inch mark like 27" in an unquoted description is treated as the start of a quoted field and swallows the rest of the line, triggering the rowShape error. Opened a draft PR proposing that a quote only open a quoted field when it's the first character of that field. text:
Triaged issue-4614:

- **Label:** bug
- **File:** `src/ingest/parser.ts` — `splitFields()` toggles `inQuotes` on any `"` character, even mid-field, so a literal inch mark (e.g. `27"`) in an unquoted description is misread as the start of a quoted field, swallowing the rest of the line and triggering the "Malformed row" error.
- **PR opened:** `repomind/issue-4614` (pr-20), proposing that a quote only opens a quoted field when it's the first character of that field.
- **Comment posted** explaining the diagnosis and the proposed fix.
